summary: The true law of the fast, with its purposes and attendant blessings, is set forth—The commandment to keep the Sabbath is given.
meta_description: The true law of the fast, with its purposes and attendant blessings, is set forth—The commandment to keep the Sabbath is given.

footnotes.note2_a: IE They do all the rituals, but lack something yet.
footnotes.note4_b: IE Fasting without spiritual motivation only engenders discomfort and irritability.
